impact.title: If it is deleted
impact.none: Nothing among the watched objects depends on it.
impact.cascade_one: Deleting it also deletes {{count}} object it owns ({{kinds}}).
impact.cascade_other: Deleting it also deletes {{count}} objects it owns ({{kinds}}).
impact.mountedBy_one: {{count}} pod mounts it: when restarted, it will fail to start.
impact.mountedBy_other: {{count}} pods mount it: restarted or new ones will fail to start.
impact.claimInUse_one: {{count}} pod uses this claim: the deletion waits until it stops (pvc-protection).
impact.claimInUse_other: {{count}} pods use this claim: the deletion waits until they stop (pvc-protection).
impact.envFrom_one: {{count}} pod reads environment variables from it: when restarted, it will fail to start.
impact.envFrom_other: {{count}} pods read environment variables from it: restarted or new ones will fail to start.
impact.templates_one: {{count}} workload names it in its pod template: its new pods will fail to start.
impact.templates_other: {{count}} workloads name it in their pod templates: their new pods will fail to start.
impact.pullSecret_one: {{count}} pod pulls images with it: new image pulls may fail.
impact.pullSecret_other: {{count}} pods pull images with it: new image pulls may fail.
impact.serviceAccount_one: {{count}} pod runs as this service account: new pods like it will be rejected.
impact.serviceAccount_other: {{count}} pods run as this service account: new pods like them will be rejected.
impact.routes_one: {{count}} route sends traffic to it: that traffic will fail.
impact.routes_other: {{count}} routes send traffic to it: that traffic will fail.
impact.tls_one: {{count}} object uses it as a TLS certificate: HTTPS there will fail.
impact.tls_other: {{count}} objects use it as a TLS certificate: HTTPS there will fail.
impact.parent_one: {{count}} route is attached to it and will stop serving.
impact.parent_other: {{count}} routes are attached to it and will stop serving.
impact.node_one: {{count}} pod runs on this node and will be removed.
impact.node_other: {{count}} pods run on this node and will be removed.
impact.boundClaims_one: {{count}} claim is bound to it: the deletion waits until it is released (pv-protection).
impact.boundClaims_other: {{count}} claims are bound to it: the deletion waits until they are released (pv-protection).
impact.storageClass_one: {{count}} volume or claim names this class: new claims with it cannot be provisioned.
impact.storageClass_other: {{count}} volumes and claims name this class: new claims with it cannot be provisioned.
impact.scaledBy_one: {{count}} autoscaler targets it and will report errors.
impact.scaledBy_other: {{count}} autoscalers target it and will report errors.
impact.class_one: {{count}} object uses this class and loses its controller.
impact.class_other: {{count}} objects use this class and lose their controller.
impact.trafficStops_one: {{count}} pod stops getting traffic through it.
impact.trafficStops_other: {{count}} pods stop getting traffic through it.
impact.budgetLost_one: {{count}} pod loses this disruption budget: a drain may evict it at any time.
impact.budgetLost_other: {{count}} pods lose this disruption budget: a drain may evict all of them at once.
impact.policyLost_one: {{count}} pod is no longer restricted by this network policy.
impact.policyLost_other: {{count}} pods are no longer restricted by this network policy.
